commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to Harold
commitResults.messageBody: Update the main class, startup banner, and documentation to use the new chatbot name.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add interactive command loop and bye handling
Add task storage, listing, and flexible bye recognition
Add task marking and unmarking with input validation
1. Add support for todo, deadline, and event task types 2. Add project-specific skill for automated UI testing
Refactor command handling with CommandType enum

commitResults.messageBody: Save every task-list change to an OS-independent relative path and load saved tasks during startup. Create missing directories automatically and skip malformed records so storage problems do not crash Harold.
Integrate automatic task persistence and its regression coverage while retaining the Level 7 feature branch in the history.

Represent deadline and event dates as LocalDate values instead of arbitrary text. Accept strict ISO dates and format them with readable English month names while keeping stored dates machine-readable.
Cover ISO date formatting, leap days, impossible dates, invalid formats, event boundaries, and date persistence across application restarts.
Integrate structured task dates, readable date formatting, validation, and regression coverage while retaining the Level 8 feature branch.

Move command input, banners, separators, and response formatting from
Harold into Ui.

This isolates presentation concerns so later parser and task-list
extractions can change application logic without duplicating or mixing
console behavior.

Move task collection state, capacity enforcement, and mutations from
Harold into TaskList.

This gives commands, storage, and UI one task-list abstraction to use and
removes manual array shifting from the application coordinator. Keeping the
existing 100-task limit preserves current behavior during the refactor.

Move application classes into packages grouped by responsibility while
keeping src/main/java as the source root.

Update imports, test discovery, launch names, and README paths to match
the packaged application. Remove the tracked compiled class and ignore
future class files so generated artifacts stay outside version control.

Cover core TaskList mutations and boundaries, TaskDate parsing, and
Storage persistence behavior with JUnit.

Document the project-wide target of testing approximately the top 50%
of highest-value methods and require test updates after code changes so
that future work maintains that target.

Set the packaged Harold class as the application entry point and name
the Shadow output harold.jar.

Document how to build, locate, and run the executable artifact so the
fat JAR workflow is reproducible across supported platforms.

Document every production class and non-private method, including
parameters, return values, exceptions, and enum values.

Also document non-trivial private parsing, serialization, and UI helpers
so generated API documentation explains both public contracts and the
important internal behavior behind them.

Add a project-specific coding-standard skill and mandate it in the agent instructions. Correct switch indentation across the codebase and declare the exception serialization identifier so future Java changes follow the required conventions.

Implement the Level 9 find command using description substring matching while preserving task order. Add TaskList unit tests and transcript UI coverage for multiple matches, no matches, and missing keywords.

Integrate Checkstyle 11 with the official SE-EDU configuration for production and test sources. Document the verification workflow, add it to the project coding-standard skill, and correct the existing violations detected by the new checks.

Extract a reusable command-response engine shared by the CLI and GUI, then add a scrollable JavaFX conversation window with keyboard submission and persistent task behavior. Configure JavaFX 25 and fat-JAR launching, add high-value engine tests, and adapt the CLI test harnesses for the new GUI package.

commitResults.messageTitle: Enhance task search with similar matches
commitResults.messageBody: Suggest up to three close task descriptions when an exact keyword match is unavailable. Distinguish similar matches from a true no-results response and cover the behavior with unit and UI test cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Restyle GUI with JetBrains Mono theme
commitResults.messageBody: Apply a dark espresso and hot-pink color palette throughout the JavaFX interface. Bundle and load JetBrains Mono regular and bold fonts so the coding-inspired typography remains consistent across systems.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use varargs to initialize task lists
commitResults.messageBody: Allow TaskList callers to supply zero or more tasks directly while retaining list-based construction for persisted and bulk data. Update focused tests to exercise the varargs API.
